title: Akabonero Mu Mayinja
intro: Mu nsi ensozi mwe zaali ziyooleddwa mu maka, omubaka yatuuka n’akabonero ak’ekyamagero okuva eri Allah. Abantu baasaba obukakafu, era ne bafuna ekitonde okuva mu lwazi olukalu. Naye amalala gaabwe gaabaleetera okujeemera okulabula, ne bassaako akabonero ku nkomerero yaabwe.
clues: Nnasindikibwa eri abantu abaali babeera mu bifo eby’okubeeramu ebyayolwa mu nsozi.
Bansomooza okuleeta ekipande, bwentyo ne nfulumya engamiya okuva mu lwazi.
Nabalagira okuleka eŋŋamira okunywa mu ddembe so si kugikolako bulabe.
Baajeemera ne basala eŋŋamira, nga bajeemera okulabula kwange.
Nalangirira nti ekibonerezo kijja kujja oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ssatu.
Ku makya, okubwatuka okw’amaanyi kwabasaanyaawo, naye nze n’abagoberezi bange twalokoka.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Okwetaaga engamiya enkazi okuva mu lwazi
Okwetaaga emmeeza ebuna okuva mu ggulu
trial.answer: Okwetaaga engamiya enkazi okuva mu lwazi

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
